    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: An ordered list named after the task; the running step and sub-step carry aria-current="step"
      - listitem: The header count reads "3 of 5 steps done"
      - listitem: Each step reads its title, state and time – "Read the bug report – Done, 8s"; a step with sub-steps is a button with aria-expanded
      - listitem: Closed sub-steps are inert, so the keyboard and screen readers skip them
      - listitem: A step that loses its sub-steps while focused keeps the focus; times, badges and status read in their own direction, so "<1s" stays "<1s" in right-to-left pages
      - listitem: A polite live region says when a step finishes, fails or waits for you
      - listitem: Focus rings show for the keyboard only (:focus-visible), in light and dark
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A short light – full at the front, fading to nothing at the back – runs from the running step down its branch into the sub-step it is on, and that dot rings once as it arrives
      - listitem: The running marker's arc goes round, its status shimmers and the timer counts up
      - listitem: A finished step's check pops in and draws itself; the line to the next step fills
      - listitem: Sub-steps fold open and closed, the branch line follows
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything changes at once and the light stays off
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Rows are fixed – 32px for a step, 24px for a sub-step, 40px and 28px on touch screens – so a changing status, timer or detail never moves another row
      - listitem: Long sub-step lists fold to five rows around where the agent is, so the card and the light stay short
      - listitem: "No steps: the header stays and a quiet \"No steps yet\" takes the list's place; a missing title reads \"Untitled step\""
      - listitem: Long titles end in … with the full text on hover; the right side never takes more than 40% of the row, so the title keeps its room
      - listitem: "Right-to-left: the trail moves to the right edge and the branch bends the other way"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Give every step a stable id – opening, closing and the live region track steps by it
      - listitem: Keep status to one word in the present – "Testing", "Writing"
      - listitem: "Sub-step titles say what happened – \"Found the empty-cart case\" – and detail a short fact: a file, a diff, a count"
      - listitem: Only one step should be running; the light goes to its running sub-step
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-atrc – --ui-atrc-accent and --ui-atrc-wash set the trail, --ui-atrc-loop the light's speed
